description: Official news and patch posts for one game from the last 30 days (newest first): patch notes, events, balance changes, boss/raid content and seasons, each with the official url, source, date, tags and a short LFG Atlas summary (not the publisher's text). Covers every LFG Atlas game with a free official feed (refreshed daily); status no_official_feed means there is no free official feed yet, so never guess. Also returns live context: the game's own player count (with source and scope, never LFG Atlas traffic) and how many LFG Atlas posts are open. Always name the source and link the official post.

game.description: Game slug or name, e.g. osrs, dragonwilds, cs2

live.description: Include live player count and open LFG post count (default true)

tag.description: Optional: only patch, event, balance, boss or season posts

name: get_game_news
title: Get a game's official updates
